factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for giant sea bass.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed giant sea bass sources describe geographic range, rocky-bottom/kelp habitat and seasonal depth movements but do not establish a numeric preferred SST or validated thermal response curve. The configured 15-23 °C range and 17-21 °C ideal remain unsupported by species-specific temperature evidence; keep values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for giant sea bass.
factors.value_notes: STRI reports 5-45 m rocky-bottom/algal-bed habitat; Aquarium of the Pacific describes adults near rocky drop-offs deeper than 30 m, juveniles on sand/mud around 21 m, and seasonal movement between shallower summer and deeper winter habitat. Other species accounts report adult ridges around 70-80 m. This supports depth as relevant but not one universal 10-100 m / 12-95 m preference across life stages and seasons.
